maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is ad-buying spend through its DSP (Adelphic, Household ID) for new campaigns, not repair or servicing of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are brands and agencies buying programmatic CTV and digital ads with private marketing budgets.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from its own DSP platform; Adelphic and IPONWEB-type deals were occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Advertisers can shift budgets among competing DSPs fairly easily; DSP is one of many ad-buying channels, despite some workflow integration.

notes: Switching costs are moderate: workflow and Household ID integration exist, but ad spend is easily reallocated.
